## 5. Breaking News (web check, last 7 days)

Validation level: **BRONZE** — press-release / secondary-source signal; primary-document verification pending.

### High-impact items
- **2026-04-28 — Boehringer Ingelheim survodutide (BI 456906) Phase 3 SYNCHRONIZE-1 hits primary endpoints in obesity.** Reported up to 16.6% mean weight loss at 76 weeks vs. 3.2% placebo. This is the first read-out of a glucagon/GLP-1 dual agonist at Phase 3 scale — relevant to the GLP-1-New domain and to combinations with retatrutide / CagriSema.
- **2026-04-22 — FDA expands Sanofi Tzield (teplizumab) to children as young as 1** to delay Stage 3 T1D in Stage 2 patients (priority review; based on PETITE-T1D Phase 4). This is the most important regulatory event in the period — directly impacts our T1D Immunotherapy domain and aligns with PMID 42051156 (consensus statement) above. **Action:** add to the tracker and fetch the PETITE-T1D primary publication.
- **2026-04-07 — FDA approved first generic dapagliflozin tablets** (HF-hospitalization-risk reduction in T2D + glycemic control). Implication: cost-access changes for an SGLT2 — relevant to Tier 1 #6 (equity analysis of SGLT2 access).

### Lower-priority / supporting
- **PIONEER TEENS** — Novo Nordisk oral semaglutide met primary endpoint in pediatric T2D (date not pinned in search; flag as ongoing).
- **TRANSCEND-T2D-1** — retatrutide in T2D, mean weight loss 16.8% at top dose (referenced as Phase 3; verify primary publication / press release date).

Nothing in this window meets the bar for an "abrupt practice change."
